description: Find businesses on bnod (Austrian local services such as hairdressers, barbers, beauty, massage) that accept online bookings. Filter by free text, category, city, a lat/lng radius or a Google Place ID. Returns slugs, addresses with coordinates, services (id, name, duration, price in euro cents) and the profile URL. Flow: search_businesses -> get_available_slots -> confirm service, date, time, team member, name and e-mail with the user -> create_booking. Bookings are only requests until the customer clicks the confirmation link e-mailed to them.

category.description: Business category (English key or German label). Known categories: Hairdresser, Barbershop, Nail salon, Beauty & spa, Massage & wellness, Tattoo & piercing, Fitness & personal training, Health & clinic, Tutoring & lessons, Pet grooming, Other.

city.description: City or district as written in the (German) address, e.g. "Wien", "1070", "Graz".

googlePlaceId.description: Exact Google Place ID of the business location, if known.

near.description: Only businesses with an address within radiusKm of this point, sorted by distance.

query.description: Free text matched against business name, category, description and service names, e.g. "Haarschnitt", "barber", "massage".

name: search_businesses
title: Search bookable businesses
